name: hex / orbital
summary: warm charcoal, orange primary, luminous green secondary and raspberry tertiary.
document: Warm charcoal surfaces with orange primary, #00e8df cyan secondary and #79aebc ice blue tertiary. Opaque meter bars use orange upper levels and red peak caps. Layout stays unchanged. Custom clip colors remain independent.
prompt: Preserve compact layout and charcoal surfaces; use orange and cyan focal accents with cool blue tertiary details.
rules: all app text uses Ioskeley Mono
flat surfaces, one-pixel dividers, no decorative cards
keep transport and track context visible
prototype states do not establish audio or device behavior
preserve Live density; minimal dead space, small gutters, compact controls and contiguous panels
structural dividers are darker than the panels; text is softened but readable
browser tags are individually outlined chips at existing compact row positions
four core accents only: blue-violet, electric blue, mint-cyan and bright orange
concept beauty takes priority over unique clip hue identification; text remains readable
clip colors are user-defined; maximum 64 saved swatches

tokens.spacing: 1 px control padding; 20 px browser/scene rows; 100 px session strips; 24 px return strips
tokens.geometry: 1900 × 1120 desktop; 418 px browser; 218 px device dock or 346 px clip editor; fine square dividers
tokens.clipPalette: theme-palette.json / clip-colors.json: 56 related shades + 8 utilities, unequal chroma by hue family
